text:
[Council File 26-1571]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to preparing a proposed ordinance to amend the Girard Tract Specific Plan or develop appropriate land use policies to require an analysis of wildlife habitat linkage and recreational value for all unimproved City-owned paper streets and walkways.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Lee for Blumenfield - Hernandez):
INSTRUCT the Department of City Planning, with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering and the City Attorney, to prepare and present a proposed ordinance to amend the Girard Tract Specific Plan or develop appropriate land use policies to require an analysis of wildlife habitat linkage and recreational value for all unimproved City-owned paper streets and walkways (or portions thereof) with widths of 22 feet or less when those paper streets and walkways are being improved, vacated or converted to any other uses.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council motion asking city planners to draft rules requiring a wildlife habitat and recreation review before unimproved city-owned paper streets and narrow walkways are improved, vacated or converted.
